AC3's bounded-expiry clause covers request expiresAt and static delivery notAfter, both of which are bounded and verified; job schedule horizon is not in AC3's enumerated coverage, AC3 forbids implementing scheduling in this lane, and docs/architecture.md records the notAfter anchoring question for job-created deliveries as a deliberate S1 open item. Flagging so the dead parameter is not mistaken for an oversight later.
